faqItems.question: What is StarsPaymee and how does it work?
faqItems.answer: StarsPaymee is a service for buying Telegram Stars, Telegram Premium and Telegram Gifts in Uzbekistan. You order through the @StarsPaymee_bot Telegram bot or the Telegram Mini App: enter a username, pick a product, pay — and the order is delivered automatically in about 10 seconds.

faqItems.question: How can I pay?
faqItems.answer: Click, Payme, Paynet, UzCard, HUMO and any Uzbek bank card — paid in UZS. No foreign card or crypto required.

faqItems.question: Do I need to log into my account for Telegram Premium?
faqItems.answer: No. In the “by username” flow no account login (password, SMS code) is needed — just the @username, and Premium activates automatically in 10 seconds. A separate “activation via account login” option is also available.
